what: Integrated Visual Sprint 1 §七 -- Phase A glass closure: the one-system fix, its verification on complete pages, and an honest visibility grade.

fix.system: renderer output transform (tone-mapping exposure), candidate lane only
fix.change: GridAppV4.start(): opticalBody === 'target-source-unclamped' renders at toneMappingExposure 1.0 -- the value the Target's output stage actually runs (r3f default ACESFilmic, three.js default exposure, no app-side assignment anywhere in the archived bundle). Control and sealed clamped lanes keep 1.05. No new constant was invented; 1.0 is the platform default the Target inherits.

verification.controlLaneInvariance: review=current before/after stills: 0 differing pixels, maxDelta 0, at ALL FOUR viewports (1440x900, 700x700, 390x844, 844x390) -- every frozen identity gate keeps its ground truth. This double-serves as the determinism proof for the still pipeline.
verification.signature: mid-tone darkening peaking at -3.4 bytes in the luma 96-160 band and tapering at both ends -- the exposure-through-ACES shape; ~80% of the frame moves 2-3.5 bytes at every viewport. On the sealed dark band's own range (luma 32-95) the shift is -2 to -2.9 bytes against a sealed residual of +7.3: the correction carries the residual's DIRECTION and closes roughly a third of it. Magnitude closure is NOT asserted; the sealed windows are not re-scored this round (§一.8).

acceptance.targetBeforeAfterFullPages: artifacts/integrated-review/{target,review-target}/stills{-before,}/ -- 4 viewports each side, labels+footer on, no overlays; shipped in the private package.
acceptance.darkContent: shadow regions of the bull cards and the dark shoulder streak bands settle deeper (the band where the fix peaks); the Target's deep-dark reading is approached, not reached.
acceptance.brightContent: white comic cards nearly unchanged (-0.6 bytes in the 224-255 band) -- highlights were already right; the fix does not wash them.
acceptance.highTexture: grass-field cards settle with the mid-tones; edge streaking unchanged (dispersion structure was ruled media-confounded, see glass-selected-problem.json notSelected).
acceptance.mobilePortrait: 390x844 pair above; the touch context runs the same lane exposure (provenance row)
acceptance.fastFlick: artifacts/integrated-review/review-target/recordings/desktop-fast-flick.mp4 (post-fix, real input); all six scenarios re-recorded post-fix

honestVisibilityGrade: SUBTLE-BUT-PAGE-WIDE. In a direct A/B flip the whole page visibly settles (mid-tones deepen everywhere, the plastic cast quiets); as an isolated glance the change is gentle. It is a true source-fidelity correction with the sealed residual's direction, not a transformative visual jump. The remaining gap to the Target's deep-dark contrast stays declared and is NOT chased further this round (§一.8).

constraintsRespected.sealedClampedLanePixelExact: keeps 1.05 by construction (lane test is target-source-unclamped only)
